BiblicalUsage: Hapharaim is a place in Palestine, named once, among the towns of Issachar. Joshua lists it between Shion and Anaharath, in the portion that fell to Issachar.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a town named once still belongs on the map: the inheritance was counted town by town, and none was too small to record.
